subject: Access to Geom, Postion and Stat from other packages

messages.author: 144ca5f8397c8b44
messages.subject: Access to Geom, Postion and Stat from other packages
parts:
For some time now I've being developing the package Rcell that uses ggplot2 to implement some plot methods. This methods are heavily inspired on qplot, and need to access the private objects Geom, Position and Stat. Until now I've being using the ':::' operator, but this causes a NOTE in the current R-devel check. 

Is there any workaround for this? 
Does it make sense to export these objects in future versions of ggplot2?

Alan
